adjudicated.en: Taichi: "...is the subject curry bread perhaps?"
adjudicated.assessment: Taichi asks whether eating curry bread counts as a class. The English turns curry bread itself into a school subject and omits the act of eating.
adjudicated.remedy: Is eating curry bread your first-period class?

adjudicated.jp: 「カレーパンがなくなるその日まで」
adjudicated.en: Sakuraba: "Until that day when curry bread itself has finally passed."
adjudicated.assessment: Sakuraba says he will continue until the day the curry bread runs out or is gone. 'Has passed' suggests death, passage, or an examination and does not express depletion.
adjudicated.remedy: until the day the curry bread runs out
